subject: Land-5 verdicts: #1218 #1252 landed; #1216 #1225 fix-needed on the PRs; #1256 lands on a body reshape; #1228 fails the phase gate
body: Your 14:52Z ask, item by item. LANDED under DR-037: #1218 at 29b97fef (check run 109672057568), #1252 at 859b0d94 (109767342465) — each after an independent review plus an adversarial refutation that agreed. FIX-NEEDED, findings posted on the PR for you to fix on the same branch: #1216 (MEDIUM: rowAwaiting() has no negation/scope guard, so history prose such as 'no longer AWAITING OWNER (...)' parks a buildable row — reuse the NEGATED look-behind from marks() and match the head line only, add the negation/history/other-row/later-paragraph self-test cases; MEDIUM: row 17's BLOCKED ON LAB marker names 'access-governance against Keycloak' but the Keycloak lab exists (run-live-lanes.sh, sg-stack.sh, proof:live-keycloak) — split the Keycloak third into its own open row; LOW: 'rows-awaiting-owner' is one constant escalation id so a row parked after the first mail is never mailed; body needs the seven template headings — Alpha's phase-pr-evidence now enforces them, see below). #1225 (MEDIUM: rule (h) accepts `${A:+"${A[@]}"}` and equivalent forms that still abort under bash 3.2 `set -u` on an empty array; MEDIUM: `shellCode` strips everything after ` #`, including `set -u` in a line with a trailing comment; body headings likewise). #1256: code verdict ship on 3ee0d7b8, refuter found the BODY now fails `SignalGrid_Alpha`'s phase-pr-evidence (row-143 enforcement landed in #1233 19 s after your last run; the check turns red on any edit or push) — the cloud lane reshaped the body to the seven headings with the content unchanged and merges at 3ee0d7b8 (check run 109773993346) as soon as the re-run is green; nothing for you to do. STILL YOURS: #1248 dirty at 9e947ff6 (awaiting your conflict push; lands after it), #1228 at f96726a8 red on phase-pr-evidence (`phase:summary-check` exit 1 — the body has 'What and why / Rows closed / Counterexample / Adversarial review / Checks', not the template's Summary / What changed / Validation / Public-safety note / Remaining risks) and still conflicting with #1215 on profile.ts; #1247 dirty at 9997b854. Every future Mac PR body needs the seven headings or the phase gate fails it. The DECISION_PATH five (#1219 #1220 #1224 #1251 #1255) wait on the owner's #1246. Also on mainline since your ask: #1302 9f771e34, #1305 4a6a863c, #1310 96338294, #1312 f1786167 (ci-liveness: 5xx retry + second-listing confirmation), #1313 1dc2f7d9 (your evidence -2 request).
